note: Active EoE (>=15 eos/hpf) treated with IL-13-neutralising antibodies (QAX576/dectrekumab, RPC4046/cendakimab); the intratracheal-IL-13 mouse and the IL-13-stimulated patient epithelial-cell transcriptome were the pivotal models, both from the Rothenberg lab.
label: EoE (anti-IL-13)

engagement.model: IL-13-stimulated patient esophageal epithelial cells (ex vivo transcriptome)
engagement.note: IL-13 alone reproduced the EoE biopsy transcriptome in patient epithelial cells; the paper proposes that signature as the read-out for anti-IL-13 target assessment.
engagement.short: IL-13 rebuilds EoE transcriptome in patient cells
engagement.quote: Furthermore, we identify an in vivo IL-13-induced transcriptome that has potential utility for target assessment after anti-IL-13 therapeutics.

engagement.model: IL-13-stimulated patient esophageal epithelial cells (ex vivo transcriptome)
engagement.note: QAX576 reversed the IL-13 transcript signature (eotaxin-3, periostin, mast-cell and barrier genes) in patient biopsies, as the epithelial-cell model said it would.
engagement.short: QAX576 reversed eotaxin-3/periostin signature in biopsies
engagement.quote: QAX576 improved expression of EoE-relevant esophageal transcripts, including eotaxin-3, periostin, and markers of mast cells and barrier function, for up to 6 months after treatment.
engagement.judgement: Called 'same' on the abstract: the registered PD endpoint of NCT01022970 was 'IL-13 dependent gene expression in esophageal biopsies', i.e. the Blanchard 2007 signature, and the abstract reports its reversal (eotaxin-3, periostin). Full text is paywalled (no PMC copy), so whether the paper itself sets the cell/mouse prediction beside the patient data is unverified (comparison_stated null). Status unchanged by the later cendakimab HEROES transcriptome paper (Caldwell, JACI 2026, doi:10.1016/j.jaci.2025.08.032), which reports the same reversal (CCL26, CPA3, DSG1, POSTN) under double-blind conditions.

efficacy.note: Anti-IL-13 (CAT-354) cut oesophageal eosinophilia in mice given human IL-13 into the lung: the class's first preclinical test in the Mishra 2003 model.
efficacy.quote: Pretreatment with CAT-354 significantly reduced AHR, airway eosinophilia and oesophageal eosinophilia.
efficacy.judgement: The model is Mishra & Rothenberg 2003 (doi:10.1016/j.gastro.2003.07.007), where intratracheal IL-13 induces esophageal eosinophilia; 2005 is the first year an anti-IL-13 antibody was dosed in it. The inducible IL-13 transgenic (Zuo 2010, doi:10.4049/jimmunol.1000471) later added eosinophil-independent remodeling that overlaps the human EoE transcriptome; it adds no status change and no antibody was dosed in it.

efficacy.note: Esophageal eosinophils fell 60% vs +23% on placebo, as the IL-13 mouse predicted; the >=75%-responder primary endpoint was missed and symptoms only trended.
efficacy.quote: Although the primary end point was not met, the mean esophageal eosinophil count decreased by 60% with QAX576 versus an increase of 23% with placebo (P = .004), and the decrease was sustained up to 6 months.
efficacy.reason: Eosinophils fell as mouse predicted; symptoms lagged
efficacy.judgement: 'same' not 'contra': the model predicted a fall in esophageal eosinophils and the fall was real (P = .004) and sustained; the miss was the trial's own responder threshold (>=75% reduction), a magnitude the mouse never quantified, so magnitude = direction_only. The mouse is silent on dysphagia, so the symptom shortfall (QAX576 'trend', then RPC4046 HEROES DSQ P = .0733 with -94.8/-99.9 vs -4.4 eos/hpf, Hirano 2019, doi:10.1053/j.gastro.2018.10.051) is outside its prediction rather than against it. No status change thereafter: the cendakimab Phase 3 (Dellon 2025, NEJM Evid, doi:10.1056/EVIDoa2500095; NCT04753697, results posted 2025-03-13) met both co-primaries, dysphagia days -6.1 vs -4.2 (P < 0.001) and histologic response 28.6% vs 2.2%. QAX576 itself was never dosed in the mouse (CAT-354 was), so product_in_model is false. Dupilumab (anti-IL-4Ra) was not used for status. Abstract-level reading; full text paywalled.
